oracle.independence: verdict derived solely from git plumbing: rev-parse --verify <rev>^{commit}; ls-tree <rev> -- <path> for mode/type/oid; cat-file -p <oid> for content
oracle.rule: exit 0 EXECUTOR_SOURCE_BOUND iff candidate entry exists, type=blob, mode in {100644,100755}, and (mode,oid) equal trusted; missing/nonregular/differing -> 1 EXECUTOR_SOURCE_DRIFT; unresolvable commit or bad trusted entry -> 2 EXECUTOR_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
